title: Dreams to Reality — PCRECOMP with new features
author: GaussRausch
selftext:
So, this isn't a new game. It's actually a game from 1997—Dreams to Reality, an old game by Cryo.

I played this during my childhood and recently remembered that I'd never completed it, so I decided to install it and get it running. And oh, the pain. It was developed around 1996 and has three modes:

* Pure DOS — software rendering
* DOS 3dfx — the holy Voodoo cards of the time
* Windows — software rendering

It's a mess. The good-looking version only runs inside DOSBox with emulated 3dfx cards.

So I thought, why not reverse-engineer it and recompile it? :)

Everything mostly works now, and I've got the Windows version running with a native renderer by porting the 3dfx code to it—yeah!!!

But the most interesting discovery wasn't getting it to work. While I was digging through Ghidra and looking at stuff, Claude started pointing out debug functions, things disabled in the game, and code that looked like it had been left behind and turned off. Even MOUSE handlers! And this game has no mouse controls!? Why is there a mouse handler and a mouse cursor?

Going deeper and deeper, Claude and I came to the conclusion that what we were actually seeing was the game's original editor! The whole editor was inside the game binary with things turned off, but most of it was just bare-bones, unfinished code with a lot of stuff missing.

Then I had an idea. These old games usually had several releases, with different languages and builds, so I grabbed every release I could find on [archive.org](http://archive.org) and started comparing them. Good results! I found code leftovers, actual 3D Studio files the developers had forgotten to remove, and a couple of function names in some versions.

But then something came to mind: if this was sloppy, what would a rushed demo version look like? So I went looking for a DEMO version of the game.

And ohhhhhh man, they shipped the DEBUG-ENABLED VERSION as the demo, with all the functions in plain sight! And guess what!? The editor was almost complete! It even had the keyboard controls they used with that weird French keyboard!

I'm just sharing this nice trip. If anyone wants to test it, you'll need the European ISOs (also on archive.org). This game isn't commercially available anywhere, so I doubt anyone will complain about this. :)



* [Dreams to Reality recompilation](https://github.com/jlagedo/dreams-to-reality-re) — my project, source code, and research.
* [Windows downloads](https://github.com/jlagedo/dreams-to-reality-re/releases) — try the recompiled game with your own discs.
* [PCRECOMP](https://github.com/sp00nznet/pcrecomp) — the static recompilation toolbox I used.
